blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) on Saturday said it is set to conduct another round of financial assistance to support affected drivers amid the oil price hikes. The DOTr said it agreed to provide another targeted financial aid through the Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) program of the Department of Social Welfare and Development. It said that the program will cover qualified transport operators and drivers. The agency did not provide further details on the planned assistance program.
